# The React component library for beautiful landing pages.

200+ production-ready components, blocks and templates built with React, Tailwind CSS and Motion. Copy, paste, customize, and ship at lightning speed without wrestling with animations or styling.

![Magic](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2Fw30v5o8i7acc9upv9qm7.png)

web.markdown:
Hello, This is the list of react components with framer motion that I have been using. All of these components are easy to use just by copy and paste. These components save me a lot of time and headaches when developing projects with animations. They are also customizable as they become your code after copy and paste into the project.

## 1\. [Aceternity UI](https://ui.aceternity.com/)

![Aceternity](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2Fact950f2v7qkpllk67bo.png)

Aceternity is the most popular library by far, it has a lot of animated ui components ready to be used.

## 2\. [Motion-primitives](https://motion-primitives.com/)

![Motion-primitives](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2Fetculh39szxq3sujusol.png)

Motion-primitives has decent animated ui components and update regularly.

## 3\. [Lukacho UI](https://ui.lukacho.com/)

![Lukacho](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2Faopb8lrag3vuaj8mgszq.png)

Lukacho UI doesn't have many components like others but still, its components are pretty useful for quick development.

## 4\. [Hover.dev](https://www.hover.dev/)

![Hover](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2Fxvmp61vms7o3ro3tjxke.png)

Not all of Hover.dev components are free but its free components are enough to develop a beautiful animated website so you should check it out.

## 5\. [Magic UI](https://magicui.design/)

![Magic](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2Fw30v5o8i7acc9upv9qm7.png)

Magic UI has a lot of cool animated components. I often use its text animations and special effects components in my projects. Magic UI is a library you should check after Aceternity UI.

## 6\. [Eldora UI](https://eldoraui.site/)

![Eldora ui](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2Fwtnatjnvfdvfxfkbweww.png)

Eldora Ui also has nice animated components and templates. Although, its "Cobe globe" lags a little when opening but others are fine, so no problem.

## 7\. [Ui-layout](https://www.ui-layouts.com/)

![Ui-layout](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2Fiwr3n1drtlrsxy28lbs5.png)

Components in Ui-layout are creative and beautiful. It is an amazing ui component library you should check out if you are looking for another cool library like Aceternity UI and Magic UI.

## 8\. [Cult-ui](https://www.cult-ui.com/)

![Cult](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2Few5syuoz3f7x25wea5pk.png)

Cult-ui is a collection of reusable components with the best use of framer motion and tailwind CSS. Like other libraries, it has a ton of animated components.

## 9\. [Animata](https://animata.design/)

![Animata](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2Fa4s6t1gjkgayrjt6arq7.png)

Animata is also a reusable components collection of animations, effects, and interactions that you can use in your project with a simple copy and paste.

## 10\. [Nyxbui](https://nyxbui.design/)

![Nyxbui](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2F8h193vwj5lp47pie45jm.png)

A fusion of Shadcn and Magic Ui which is pretty cool if you are planning to use both in your project.

## 11\. [Edilozi](https://www.edilozi.pro/)

![Edilozi](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2Fh6q43vld58w5syeh7f6r.png)

Edilozi has beautifully animated components and effects that you can copy and paste into your project.

## 12\. [Variant Vault](https://variantvault.chrisabdo.dev/)

![Variantvault](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2Fo8q58bl0c4bihcv1jdum.png)

Variant Vault has cool text animations with framer motion.

## 13\. [CodeUi](https://www.codeui.co.in/)

![Codeui](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2F5iezr6rdsvjkpxun11t9.png)

CodeUi components library has eye-catching designs with animated components ready to be used.

## 14\. [Syntaxui](https://syntaxui.com/)

![Syntaxui](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2Fdlipzzkgtijnflx1lmch.png)

SyntaxUi has simple minimalistic animated components for free. There is also a paid version called Syntaxui Pro.

## 15\. [Cuicui](https://cuicui.day/)

![Cuicui](https://media2.dev.to/dynamic/image/width=800%2Cheight=%2Cfit=scale-down%2Cgravity=auto%2Cformat=auto/https%3A%2F%2Fdev-to-uploads.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fuploads%2Farticles%2Fnm9maqbrj3ilyuo8cbbn.png)

web.description: Motion (prev Framer Motion) is a fast, production-grade animation library for React, JavaScript and Vue. Build smooth UI animations at a tiny footprint.
web.markdown:
FreeCompletely free to use, MIT licensed and open source.

Production readyTrusted by Framer and Figma across hundreds of thousands of sites.

Hybrid engineJavaScript and hardware-accelerated browser APIs in one library.

Built for AIAgent-compatible documentation, skills and API.

Tiny footprintAPIs up to 90% smaller than their GSAP alternative.

01

### [Independent transforms](https://motion.dev/docs/react-animation)

Animate `x`, `y`, `rotate`, `scale` on the same element, without wrappers.

{ rotate: 15, x: "50%" }

02

### [Scroll animation](https://motion.dev/docs/react-scroll-animations)

Hardware-accelerated scroll-linked motion via `ScrollTimeline`.

scroll()

- hover
- press
- drag

03

### [Native gestures](https://motion.dev/docs/react-gestures)

`hover`, `press`, and `drag` that feel native, not bolted on.

drag=true

04

### [Layout animation](https://motion.dev/docs/react-layout-animations)

Animate between any two layouts with a single `layout` prop.

layout=true

05

### [Spring physics](https://motion.dev/docs/react-transitions)

Real `spring` math for animations that naturally react to user input.

type="spring"

06

### [Exit animation](https://motion.dev/docs/react-animate-presence)

`AnimatePresence` keeps elements alive so they can animate as they leave the DOM.

exit={...}

07

### [Timeline sequences](https://motion.dev/docs/react-animation)

`variants`, `stagger`, and timelines orchestrate complex motion.

stagger(0.04)

08

### [Motion values](https://motion.dev/docs/react-motion-value)

`useMotionValue` drives animations and derived state in real time.

useTransform(() =\> x.get() \\* 10)

![60+ Best Free React UI Libraries & Component Kits for 2025](https://www.orbit.build/_next/image?url=%2Fthumbnails%2Freact-components-libraries.webp&w=3840&q=75)

Stop reinventing the wheel. These are the libraries and tools that ship products — battle-tested, community-loved, and ready to drop into your next project.

## The Essentials

These are the foundational libraries every React developer should know.

- [**shadcn/ui**](https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/installation) — The gold standard. Copy-paste components you own. Built on Radix + Tailwind.
- [**Radix UI**](https://www.radix-ui.com/themes/docs/overview/getting-started) — Unstyled, accessible primitives that power shadcn.
- [**Tailwind CSS**](https://tailwindcss.com/docs/installation/using-vite) — Utility-first CSS. If you're not using it in 2025, you're working too hard.
- [**Lucide Icons**](https://lucide.dev/packages) — 1000+ beautiful, consistent icons. Fork of Feather.

* * *

## Animation Libraries

Make your UI feel alive.

- [**Motion (Framer Motion)**](https://motion.dev/docs/react) — The React animation library. Simple, declarative, production-ready.
- [**Motion Primitives**](https://motion-primitives.com/docs) — Copy-paste animations built with Framer Motion.
- [**Animate UI**](https://animate-ui.com/docs/icons) — Pre-built animated icons and components.

* * *

## shadcn Ecosystem

The shadcn universe is massive. Here's the best of it.

- [**Magic UI**](https://magicui.design/docs) — 50+ free animated components. React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Framer Motion.
- [**Aceternity UI**](https://ui.aceternity.com/components) — Stunning animated components. Hero sections and card effects are _chef's kiss_.
- [**shadcn Examples**](https://shadcnexamples.com/) — Real-world examples, templates, and inspiration.
- [**21st.dev (shadcn.io)**](https://www.shadcn.io/components) — Extended shadcn component library.
- [**shadcn Templates**](https://www.shadcn.io/template/serafimcloud-21st) — Premium templates built with shadcn.
- [**shadcn Studio**](https://shadcnstudio.com/#pricing) — Visual builder for shadcn components.
- [**Shadway**](https://shadway.online/) — More shadcn variants and templates.
- [**shadcn UI Kit**](https://shadcnuikit.com/components) — Pre-built component compositions.

* * *

## Premium-Quality Free Libraries

These punch way above their weight class.

- [**HeroUI**](https://www.heroui.com/docs/guide/introduction) — Beautiful, fast, modern. Check out [Scroll Shadow](https://www.heroui.com/docs/components/scroll-shadow).
- [**Base UI**](https://base-ui.com/react/overview/quick-start) — Unstyled components from the MUI team.
- [**Headless UI**](https://headlessui.com/react/menu) — Unstyled, accessible components from Tailwind Labs.
- [**Chakra UI**](https://chakra-ui.com/docs/components/hover-card) — Modular and accessible. Great defaults.
- [**Ant Design**](https://ant.design/components/drawer?theme=dark) — Enterprise-grade. Massive component library.
- [**DaisyUI**](https://daisyui.com/components/carousel/) — Tailwind component library. Add classes, get components.
- [**Preline**](https://preline.co/docs/index.html) — Open-source Tailwind components. Clean, modern.

* * *

## Specialty & Niche Libraries

Specific use cases, exceptional execution.

- [**Vercel AI SDK Elements**](https://ai-sdk.dev/elements/overview) — Components for AI interfaces. Chat UIs, streaming responses.
- [**COBE**](https://cobe.vercel.app/) — 5kb WebGL globe. That spinning globe you've seen everywhere.
- [**Three.js**](https://threejs.org/) — The 3D library for the web.
- [**Shaders by Paper**](https://shaders.paper.design/) — Beautiful WebGL shaders.
- [**Eldora UI**](https://www.eldoraui.site/docs/components/terminal) — Terminal components for React.
- [**Vyoma UI**](https://www.vyomaui.design/ai-components/magical-chat-input) — AI-focused components. Chat inputs, response bubbles.

* * *

## Component Collections & Blocks

Pre-built sections and layouts.

- [**Animata**](https://animata.design/docs/hero/hero-section) — Animated hero sections and page blocks.
- [**Blocks.so**](https://blocks.so/sidebar) — Navigation components and sidebars.
- [**ReUI Blocks**](https://reui.io/blocks/cards/statistic-cards) — Dashboard cards and data viz blocks.
- [**Pace UI**](https://ui.paceui.com/docs/blocks/hero) — Landing page blocks and hero sections.
- [**Kokonut UI**](https://kokonutui.com/docs/components/file-upload) — File upload, drag-and-drop, forms.

* * *

## Emerging Libraries

New kids on the block worth watching.

- [**Cult UI**](https://www.cult-ui.com/docs/components/texture-overlay) — Texture overlays and visual effects.
- [**Neobrutalism.dev**](https://www.neobrutalism.dev/docs/button) — Bold, chunky, unapologetic design.
- [**8bitcn**](https://www.8bitcn.com/) — Retro 8-bit style components.
- [**Solace UI**](https://www.solaceui.com/) — Calm, minimal components.
- [**Fancy Components**](https://www.fancycomponents.dev/docs/introduction) — Unique, creative components.
- [**Hexa UI**](https://www.hextaui.com/docs/ui/components/video-player) — Video players, [radio groups](https://www.hextaui.com/components/radio-group), media.
- [**Smooth UI**](https://smoothui.dev/doc/components/image-metadata-preview) — Image metadata preview and file handling.
- [**Dice UI**](https://www.diceui.com/docs/components/masonry) — Masonry layouts and grids.
- [**Scroll X UI**](https://www.scrollxui.dev/docs/components) — Scroll-based animations.
- [**Bundui**](https://bundui.io/components/animated-gradient-border) — Animated borders and gradients.
- [**Lightswind**](https://lightswind.com/components/chain-carousel) — Carousels and sliders.
- [**Simply UI**](https://www.simplyui.io/components/shimmer-button) — Shimmer buttons and loading states.
- [**Kibo UI**](https://www.kibo-ui.com/components/dropzone) — Dropzone and file upload.
- [**Sera UI**](https://seraui.com/docs/svg-icons) — SVG icons.
- [**Align UI**](https://alignui.com/) — Clean, aligned components.
- [**Coss UI**](https://coss.com/ui/docs/components/dialog) — Dialog and modal components.
- [**Square by LN**](https://square.lndev.me/) — Minimal, square-based design.

* * *

## Design Tools

Not components, but essential for building UIs.

- [**Gradienty**](https://gradienty.codes/) — Beautiful CSS gradients. Copy-paste ready.
- [**Border Radius Playground**](https://design.dev/tools/border-radius-playground/) — Visualize complex border-radius.
- [**Red Ketchup Icon Converter**](https://redketchup.io/icon-converter) — Convert to favicons and app icons.
- [**Lordicon**](https://lordicon.com/icons/system/regular/121-bulb) — Animated icons in Lottie, GIF, JSON.
- [**Nucleo App**](https://nucleoapp.com/app/) — Icon manager and organizer.

* * *

## Enterprise & Dashboard

When you're building serious applications.

- [**Ionic Framework**](https://ionicframework.com/docs/api/action-sheet) — Cross-platform mobile and web.
- [**Keen Themes**](https://keenthemes.com/#products) — Admin dashboard templates.

* * *

## Getting Started

1. **Start with shadcn/ui** — it's the foundation
2. **Add Magic UI or Aceternity** — for animations
3. **Use Motion** — for custom animations
4. **Pick specialty libraries** — as needed

The React component ecosystem has never been better. Stop building from scratch. Ship faster.
